scalars.scalar_value: One (1) year experience in a centralized scheduling call center setting or minimum of two (2) years clinical experience in a health care setting

items.item_text: One (1) year experience in a centralized scheduling call center setting or minimum of two (2) years clinical experience in a health care setting
Keyboarding skills and the ability to utilize computer equipment and software are required as is experience with other types of standard office equipment

Manages comprehensive patient scheduling in Cerner & GECB, including medical history, device screening, medication/lab instructions, exam prep, demographics, insurance, authorization, eligibility, and prior imaging coordination for comparison
Proactively contributes to organizational quality and performance improvement through identifying opportunities and participating in team-based initiatives and projects
Demonstrates responsible resource management by adapting to organizational changes and utilizing materials, equipment, and finances efficiently and cost-effectively
Effectively plans and prioritizes work, collaborating with others, utilizing time efficiently, and consistently meeting deadlines and achieving desired outcomes

Exhibits professional and empathetic interpersonal skills, always prioritizing the patient, demonstrating respect and courtesy in all interactions, and consistently wearing identification for easy recognition
Actively supports departmental and organizational goals through timely and confidential communication, embracing team consensus, and demonstrating effective teamwork
Team player, able to multi-task, self-starter, detail oriented and proactive
Excellent interpersonal, organizational and customer service skills
Familiarity with an electronic practice management system
